name: list_projects
description: List the projects this agent key can reach in its workspace. Membership alone grants nothing; only projects in the key's scope appear.

workspaceId.description: The workspace the key is scoped to

name: get_project
description: Read one project the agent key has Read access to.

name: list_issues
description: List the issues in an in-scope project.

name: get_issue
description: Read one issue in an in-scope project. The issue includes its structured links (PRs, commits, docs and other web URLs) with each link's kind.

name: create_issue
description: Create an issue in an in-scope project. Requires Contribute access on the key and on its human owner.

name: update_issue
description: Edit an issue's title or body, or close/reopen it. Requires Contribute access. The actor recorded is the agent, not its human owner.

name: list_comments
description: List the comments on an in-scope issue.

name: create_comment
description: Comment on an in-scope issue. Requires Contribute access.

name: add_issue_link
description: Attach a PR, commit, external doc, or other web URL to an in-scope issue. Requires Contribute access. Only http and https URLs are accepted, and the same URL cannot be attached twice to one issue. The actor recorded is the agent, not its human owner.

name: remove_issue_link
description: Remove a previously attached link from an in-scope issue. Requires Contribute access. Removing a link that is not attached is an error, not a silent no-op.

name: list_activity
description: Read an in-scope project's activity feed, including which agent performed each action.

name: list_knowledge
description: List the knowledge entries in an in-scope project.

name: get_knowledge
description: Read one knowledge entry in an in-scope project.

name: create_knowledge
description: Create a knowledge entry in an in-scope project. Requires Contribute access.

name: update_knowledge
description: Edit a knowledge entry in an in-scope project. Requires Contribute access.

name: orrery_run_checkin
description: Report a harness conversation's identity and metadata. Correlate by an explicit runId or by the harness's (harness, nativeSessionId) key — send runKey as null when only a runId is known; a new key starts a run, the same key resumes it. Report model and harnessVersion directly or under `reported` (#29); they are stored only as reported and missing values stay unknown. This tool does not claim work or renew a lease.

name: claim_issue
description: Claim an issue this agent needs to work on, for this agent and run. The issue may already be closed: a worker reopening it must claim it first, because a fenced update_issue needs a live session. One active session per issue: a second worker is refused. Helpers on the same issue pass the same runId and join the existing session. The claim is a five-minute lease in database time; renew it while working.

name: renew_claim
description: Check in on an issue this agent currently holds and refresh its five-minute lease in database time. Requires a live session; an expired or released session is never renewed or silently reacquired. Pass sessionId to fence a delayed call from an interrupted session: it is refused if that session is no longer the live one, even after reacquisition.

name: report_progress
description: Record progress on the live session this agent holds for an issue. Progress is stored independently of the lease, so an interruption never erases it. Requires a live session; pass sessionId to refuse a delayed report from an expired session instead of writing to a newer one.

name: stop_session
description: Complete or release the live session this agent holds for an issue. Requires a live session; stopping is distinct from closing the issue. Pass sessionId to fence a delayed completion from an interrupted session: it is refused rather than completing a newer session.

name: get_work_session
description: Read the latest work session recorded for an issue, from any agent, including its recorded progress and lease deadline. This is a read: it needs no live claim and never renews one.

name: resume_work_session
description: Inspect the work session the given run (the harness conversation, including resumes) recorded for an issue. Returns disposition active, expired, ended or none, and the session with its recorded progress. This is a read in database time: it never renews or resurrects an expired lease.

name: reacquire_issue
description: Reacquire this run's expired claim on an issue after an interruption. Creates a new active session for the same agent, run, workspace and issue, carrying forward the recorded progress, and only when no other worker holds a live claim and the issue is not paused for input. Retries with the same run return the same session; a stale call on an expired session is refused, never turned into a fresh claim.

name: ready_work
description: List minimal ready work in a project: open issues that are not Needs input and have no live active session, evaluated in database time. Needs no claim.

name: list_work_sessions
description: List the work sessions recorded for an issue, including completed, released and expired ones. This is a read and needs no claim.

name: ask_for_input
description: Ask the team a blocking question about an issue this agent currently holds. Include a concrete proposed fallback; the agent cannot authorize it. The question opens for one hour in database time, keeps the claim while the agent checks in, sets the issue to Needs input and emails the agent's owner. A human with Contribute or Manage answers through the inbox; at the deadline with no authorized fallback the question is paused, the claim released, and the issue stays Needs input until a human answers.

name: list_issue_questions
description: List every question asked about an in-scope issue and its resolution, newest first. A pending question may be reported as paused in database time once its one-hour deadline has passed. Needs no claim; answering remains a human-only REST operation.
